criteria.description: When productId changes from null to a non-null value, focus must be programmatically moved to the close button (.detail-close-btn) before the browser paints, implemented via useLayoutEffect reacting to the isOpen derived value.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:58-61 — useLayoutEffect with [isOpen] dependency; when isOpen is true, calls panelRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.detail-close-btn')?.focus(). useLayoutEffect fires synchronously before browser paint.

criteria.description: A useRef (prevFocusRef) must capture document.activeElement at the moment the panel opens — inside the same useLayoutEffect that handles focus-on-open, before calling .focus() on the close button.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:60-61 — line 60 assigns prevFocusRef.current = document.activeElement, then line 61 calls .focus() on the close button. Assignment precedes focus call inside the same useLayoutEffect when isOpen is true.

criteria.description: When the panel closes (isOpen transitions from true to false), focus must be restored to the element captured in requirement 2 by calling .focus() on prevFocusRef.current, provided it is an HTMLElement or SVGElement.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:63-69 — else branch of useLayoutEffect: 'if (prevFocusRef.current instanceof HTMLElement || prevFocusRef.current instanceof SVGElement) { prevFocusRef.current.focus(); }'. Both type guards present before .focus() call.

criteria.description: A document-level keydown event listener must be registered when the panel is open, calling onClose when event.key === 'Escape'. Must be attached via addEventListener on document (not React's onKeyDown prop).
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:73-82 — useEffect with [isOpen, onClose] dependency: 'document.addEventListener("keydown", handler)' where handler calls 'if (event.key === "Escape") onClose()'. Not attached via React onKeyDown prop.

criteria.description: The document-level Escape listener registered in requirement 4 must be removed when the panel closes or the component unmounts — implemented via the cleanup return of the useEffect that registers it.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:79-81 — cleanup return in the same useEffect: 'return () => { document.removeEventListener("keydown", handler); };'. Listener is removed when isOpen becomes false or component unmounts.

criteria.description: While the panel is open, Tab must wrap focus to the next/previous focusable element inside the panel; Shift+Tab wraps in reverse. Focusable elements matched by FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR. event.preventDefault() called to prevent focus leaving the panel.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:85-109 — useEffect attaches document-level keydown handler; queries panelRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR); on Tab with last focused calls event.preventDefault() + first.focus(); on Shift+Tab with first focused calls event.preventDefault() + last.focus().

criteria.description: Clicking the backdrop (.detail-backdrop) must still call onClose — the existing onClick={onClose} on the backdrop must not be removed.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:119 — backdrop div has onClick={onClose}. pnpm test output: '✓ tests/productDetailFocus.test.tsx (5 tests) 231ms' — test 'clicking the backdrop closes the panel' passed.

criteria.description: Clicking the close button must still call onClose — the existing onClick={onClose} on the close button must not be removed.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:142 — close button has onClick={onClose}. pnpm test output: '✓ tests/productDetailFocus.test.tsx (5 tests) 231ms' — test 'clicking the close button closes the panel' passed.

criteria.description: The scroll lock (document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden' on open, '' on close) must continue to function unchanged.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:49-55 — scroll-lock useEffect present and unmodified: sets document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden' when isOpen, resets to '' in cleanup. pnpm test output: '✓ tests/productDetailFocus.test.tsx (5 tests) 231ms' — 0 failures.

criteria.description: The component must use ReactDOM.createPortal into document.body — the portal mounting must not be changed.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx:113 — 'return ReactDOM.createPortal(…, document.body);' is present and unchanged. pnpm test: test 'clicking a product card opens the detail panel' passed (dialog found in document via portal).

criteria.description: No new npm packages may be added — all focus management must be implemented inline in ProductDetailPanel.tsx only.
criteria.evidence: package.json has 3 dependencies (react, react-dom, react-router-dom) and 8 devDependencies — no new entries. Focus management uses only React built-ins (useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef) inline in ProductDetailPanel.tsx.

criteria.description: The TypeScript build must succeed with no type errors.
criteria.evidence: pnpm tsc --noEmit exited with code 0 and produced no output (no type errors).
